subject: PO header flags & net-term timing for invoice waves
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@harborhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, treasury@harborhealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Hi Sergio —

Quick one from procurement as we prep the PO for the pilot contract: our AP team requires a specific PO header field ("BU_CODE") and a certificate of insurance line item to sit in the PO metadata. They also prefer net-45 terms, but treasury is pushing for net-60 unless we can do monthly invoice waves instead of single monthly statements (they want earlier recognition). Can you confirm if Redwood can: 1) accept the BU_CODE field in the PO header (exact key name); 2) attach a COI reference in the PO; and 3) support split-invoice waves (e.g., invoice on day 1 for usage through 15th, invoice on day 16 for rest) while still honoring net-45 on each invoice?

I've attached Harbor_PO_Template_v1.pdf showing the fields they expect. Can you loop in finance/ops and advise any constraints?

Thanks,
Emily Carter
Senior Procurement Manager
Harbor Health

Attachments: Harbor_PO_Template_v1.pdf (PDF, 145KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Emily —

Thanks for the clear summary and the template. Short answers up-front:
1) BU_CODE in PO header: yes, we can map an arbitrary PO header key to our billing metadata — we call that the "external_tag" field on our invoices. We'll need the exact key string you plan to send so we can validate it during onboarding.
2) COI reference: yes, we can include a COI reference number in the PO, and surface it in our invoice metadata. If you need the actual certificate file attached to the invoice packet we can discuss secure transfer; typically customers host the COI and include a URL in the PO.
3) Split invoice waves: possible, but there are two constraints: a) our billing run cadence is configurable but our standard hosted billing runs are monthly by default — we can enable semi-monthly runs (1st and 16th) for enterprise customers with a billing-lane configuration; b) net terms apply per invoice, so if we issue two invoices each month and both are net-45, Treasury would have two separate due-dates — that should satisfy their recognition preference.

I cc'd Vanessa to confirm any pricing/discount implications if we change cadence or accept a net-60 vs net-45. Vanessa — can the pricing team confirm whether the monthly recognition + net-60 ask would require a revision to the discount slab?

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Carter <emily.carter@harborhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Thanks — looping Kim from pricing/finance: Kim, quick context: Harbor Health wants BU_CODE in PO header + COI reference, and prefers net-60 unless we can provide semi-monthly invoice waves (they'd like two invoices per month so recognition happens sooner). They are currently requesting our standard enterprise discount (15% on committed capacity).

Three points from pricing perspective:
- Net term change (net-60) typically increases credit risk and we price that via either a smaller discount or a prepay holdback. For a large enterprise like Harbor we can consider a 12% slab if they push net-60.
- Semi-monthly billing is operationally fine for Dedicated/Private customers, and for Hosted customers if they opt into the "billing lane" add-on. There is a small per-invoice processing fee ($65 per additional invoice run) we should disclose.
- BU_CODE and COI fields are fine; we just need the exact key names and whether the COI will be a URL or file attachment.

Emily — Kim, can you confirm the adjusted slab if Harbor accepts net-45 but requires semi-monthly waves? We should also surface the per-invoice run fee up front.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@harborhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and invoice cadence question

Emily / team —

Appreciate the clarity. Summary of what Redwood can commit to (to include in the SOW / PO acceptance):
1) PO header mapping: we will accept BU_CODE as an exact header key; please confirm capitalization (recommended: BU_CODE). We will validate the field on ingestion and return a PO-ack with the parsed BU_CODE in our invoice metadata.
2) COI: acceptable as either a hosted URL in the PO (preferred) or an attached file. If Harbor will attach the certificate, route it to secure-billing@redwoodinference.com and we will link it to the account.
3) Invoice cadence: we can set semi-monthly invoice waves (1st / 16th) as a billing lane option. Operational notes: each invoice will carry its own net-45 due date by default. If Harbor insists on net-60 overall, pricing will be adjusted as Vanessa noted.

Pricing impact options (choose one):
- Option A: Keep requested discount (15%) + net-45 on each invoice + semi-monthly waves -> No price change, customer accepts two payment obligations per month.
- Option B: Accept net-60 across invoices -> reduce discount to 12% OR require a 30-day rolling prepay holdback of 10% until initial 3 months.
- Option C: Keep net-45 but waive the per-invoice processing fee for 6 months as a courtesy (requires CSM approval).

Next steps: Emily, if Harbor confirms BU_CODE capitalization and whether COI will be a URL or file, we'll prepare an amended SOW/PO acceptance template and the Redwood_PO_Response_Template.xlsx (attached) with the billing lane flag and pricing options. Once you confirm, Sergio / Vanessa will review final redlines and I can upload the PO-ack to the shared Drive link.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Response_Template.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)
